description.value: This Walmart Supercenter on Saanich Road in Victoria is a large-format retailer carrying groceries alongside electronics, clothing, furniture, and more. As one of the area's major big-box stores, it offers a broad range of supplies that a touring cyclist might need to restock — from food staples to basic household goods. The store is wheelchair accessible and offers public Wi-Fi.
